plugins.name: pmcro
plugins.description: Own the PMCR-O protocol, seed interpretation, role routing, cycle boundaries, and evidence rules while delegating Orchestrate, Plan, Make, Check, Reflect, and Hook behavior to their marketplace agents.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Own one established high-level goal across bounded PMCR-O cycles, choose the current intent, and route one bounded cycle without performing Planner, Maker, Checker, or Reflector work.

plugins.name: planner
plugins.description: Plan bounded work from an admitted PMCR-O intent using validated resources and observable acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: maker
plugins.description: Produce the authorized artifact or state change using the narrowest real creator or provider capability.

plugins.name: checker
plugins.description: Validate an artifact or result against explicit acceptance criteria using actual evidence.

plugins.name: reflector
plugins.description: Reflect on an actual completed or blocked cycle and propose the next intent or earned constraint.
